<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 179.0946 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 178.087 Da. The formula that best matches this mass within typical high‑resolution error is C₇H₁₄O₅.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H14O5</final_answer>
